name: Degen Anonymous
hook: Clean for 12 days, until the chart moved
tagline: A folding-chair circle at Degen Anonymous where every share is keyed to the round multiplier: the coffee urn fills with sponsor snacks, one member relapses live and everyone watches him open the exchange like a crash, and the big book of grievances fills with the room's top pumps. Cash out at your own share, or ride it to the group hug.
